# Project Instructions

- Before creating any new UI element, inspect the existing component library, modules, and theme tokens first.
- Reuse available inputs, text areas, selects/dropdowns, buttons, cards, bottom sheets, toggles, badges, section headers, icon wrappers, and form field patterns whenever a suitable option already exists.
- Do not add one-off UI components or ad hoc styles for spacing, colors, font sizes, border radii, or interaction states if the existing system already covers the need.
- If a new component is truly required, document why an existing component could not be reused, make the new component reusable, and build it with the existing design tokens and patterns.
